human_view.title: PROVE — provenance, evidence, epistemic state, lineage
human_view.essence: PROVE derives bounded evidence-backed claims from persisted KNOW output and canonical evidence, surfaces conflicts, preserves scope/limitations, and refuses unsupported promotion.
human_view.why: One responsibility of the single NayaPOWER brain; not an independent brain or authority.
human_view.uncertainty: PROVE V1 is implemented and repository-verified on this branch; live deployment and bounded live proof remain pending.

ai_view.purpose: Assess whether a persisted KNOW selection supports a scoped claim without caller-supplied proof content, authority creation, or outcome/causal overclaiming.
ai_view.failure_mode: fail closed on stale/malformed KNOW receipt, invalid live authority, non-HIT input, missing/mismatched canonical block/provenance/evidence, scope mismatch, supersession, or unresolved/verified contradiction
ai_view.non_responsibility_law: Do not silently absorb responsibilities owned by another Master Node.

proof.limitation: PROVE V1 assesses evidence/epistemic support only. It does not prove behavioral outcome or causality; VERIFY remains a separate responsibility. Universal nine-node runtime binding remains NOT_PROVEN.

successor_effect: Preserve only the semantic state needed for future continuation; never manufacture authority.
